quote: A long series of cleverly designed experiments, which weeded out alternative hypotheses and nailed down the standard interpretation
content: Fable is right that the essay overstates agreement about the psychological mechanism. But a disagreement between representativeness and confirmation-based explanations leaves the nested-event constraint intact, and the clearer betting results in Sides et al. (2002) support treating at least some violations as real. Preserve the practical warning about conjunctions while downgrading the claim that a single mechanism has been nailed down.

quote: feel every added detail as a burden, even a single extra roll of the dice
content: Assigning a specific claim lower probability than the broader claim it entails does not mean preferring vagueness as a scientific explanation. A hypothesis can be more informative and more useful while remaining less probable than its disjunction with alternatives. The essay warns against upgrading a scenario merely because an added detail makes a better story; predictive evidence can justify that detail, but narrative attractiveness cannot substitute for it.

quote: where the absurdity is the log probability, so you can add it
content: The displayed addition needs conditional probabilities: −log₂ P(A∩B) = −log₂ P(A) − log₂ P(B|A). Fable correctly catches the unjustified independence in the numerical example, but dependence does not remove the burden altogether because P(B|A) cannot exceed one. An entailed detail adds zero burden; a merely compatible detail cannot make the conjunction more probable than A.
